payload.summary: Follow-up design consult complete (codex): A1 retraction SHIP-IT (roadmap.column-retracted {event,reason}, three lifecycle targets only, agents may retract, surfaces in awaiting-your-eyes, winner excludes retracted, no retracting retractions — re-log the fact instead); A2 SHIP-IT (stage advances to tested only on failed===0; invalid failed stays dev + warning); A3 COUNTER accepted: archival gates on ALL THREE release keys (version/channel/announcement) nonblank on the winning unretracted event, refusal names event+missing keys, roadmap.prd-archived records the supporting release event id, unarchived-check parity, render stays permissive (stage released vs archival-qualified release now deliberately distinct — glossary); B SHIP-IT (childless epic maps own status: backlog->planned, live->in-flight, done->built, dropped->planned+warning; descendants-exist keeps rollup); C1 COUNTER-narrow accepted: candidates = top-level AND not dropped (incl done), pre-history step DROPPED for now (false-history hazard: epicless node renders planned while claiming shipped) — historical-import to be designed separately, follow-up noted; C2 COUNTER accepted: migration ATTRIBUTION — node-created events carry migration=<selection-event-id>, audit binds only attributed nodes (strict-ts, exact set match, no excluded/unlisted), ordinary later nodes ignored, two active selections = one error + audit suspended; C3 COUNTER accepted: real recovery verb nahel roadmap migration supersede <selection-id> --reason — crash-repairable sequence moving attributed nodes to nahel/roadmap/failed/<selection-id>/, refuses if later maps/nodes reference them, journal intact, one fresh selection permitted after; D1 accepted with additions: decisions AND ticket-backed out-of-scope both DERIVED from tickets sorted by resolution/close event canonical order (never ticket.updated — distillation moves it), only pre-ticket map-owned notes stay stored; D2 SHIP-IT (multiline --rationale into observation body, closed tickets distill closed-<id> observations with disposition); E SHIP-IT (streamed baseline, retraction renders as correction — history never erased retroactively). Build order: A+B one worker, then C, then D, then E.
